items.summary: Closed 2026-05-14 self-directed: picked R7 (multi-teacher BC blend) over R8. Reasoning in docs/ai-agent-state/escalations.md `## Resolved`.

Scoping doc landed at docs/ai-research/scoping/r7-multi-teacher-warmstart.md (113 lines). Key wins: train_bc.py:361-369 already implements soft-target CE (R12 phase C) so no trainer change; three teachers already wired (rollout/search/planner). Pre-flight pairwise-teacher-agreement probe built into step 1 as cheap go/no-go.

GO. N=300 in 1m 46s. rollout↔search=0.800 (in [0.30,0.85] band), rollout↔planner=0.180, search↔planner=0.230. All-three-agree=0.133 (< 0.50). Mean normalised mixture entropy=0.618. Diversity hypothesis confirmed: planner is structurally different from rollout/search (turn-bundle planning vs greedy leaf), provides genuine per-state disagreement. NO-GO-reweight rule did not fire (rollout↔search stays in band). Planner is ~14× slower per state than rollout (315ms vs 13ms) — projects to +5–6 min trace-gen wall-clock if all three teachers run on every row. Probe at backend/src/sim/r7TeacherAgreementProbe.ts; output at runs/R7-pre-flight-teacher-agreement/probe-300-20260514T061913Z.json. Result block appended to docs/ai-research/scoping/r7-multi-teacher-warmstart.md § 8.

TS schema change landed + back-compat preserved. `DecisionTraceRow.teacher` → `teachers: Array<...>` (length 1-3); `chooseTraceTeacher` calls all requested selectors with per-teacher sub-seeds; `parseTraceTeacher` accepts comma-separated CLI; relabel emits `policyTargets: number[]` with uniform 1/K weights. New smoke `backend/src/tests/multiTeacherTraceSmoke.ts` asserts mixed + single paths. All 6 train smokes PASS (~60s).

R7 step 3 (per scoping § 6): plumb `policyTargets` through the Python SL dataset loader. `training/train_bc.py:361-369` already routes `policy_targets`-bearing batches to soft-CE — the missing piece is the loader. Mirror the MCTS-visits pattern at `training/uma_ai/selfplay_dataset.py:125-135`. Adapter must pad to `max_actions` consistent with `collate_policy_batch` (around `training/uma_ai/dataset.py:82-109`).

Phase O prerequisite landed. Added `valueEstimate?: number` to both `BehaviorPolicySnapshot` declarations (`backend/src/sim/evaluateModelVsHeuristic.ts:140-147`, `backend/src/sim/dagger/relabelDecisionTrace.ts:5-12`); added `value?: number[]` to the `/predict` payload destructure; copied `payload.value?.[0]` onto the snapshot when it is a finite number. Updated `evalGateSmoke.ts` fake-server to emit `value: [0.42]` and added an assertion that policy-source trace rows carry numeric `behaviorPolicy.valueEstimate ≈ 0.42`. `TMPDIR=/tmp npm run test:train` PASS post-diff.

Phase O CLOSED — REGRESSED. iter-2 Wilson 0.3502 (WR 39.2%), 1.8pp worse than Phase N's 0.3677. Trajectory 0.2845 (promoted) → 0.2768 (REJECTED at floor 0.2845, same over-shape pattern as Phase M) → 0.3502 (promoted from iter-0 parent). `promoted_iterations: [0, 2]`. Wall-clock 5m 22s. Mechanism diagnosis: signal correctly wired but magnitude is ~20× the design budget — Tanh output range ±1 gives per-step delta ±2; at coef 0.05 per-step contribution is ±0.1; at ~60 steps/game per-game total is ±6, vs ±0.3 budget. iter-0 shape_attribution.value_head=26.01 confirms empirically; iter-1/2 attributions drop to 9.28/8.25 as policy flattens the delta (over-shape signature). PPO healthy in all non-reward dimensions (ratio_max 12.7/12.3/22.4, entropy stable, no anomalies). Follow-up: Phase P launched at coef 0.01 (5× smaller). Full writeup at docs/ai-performance-research-progress.md § Phase O.

Phase P CLOSED — REGRESSED. iter-2 Wilson **0.3463** (WR 38.8%), **2.1pp worse than Phase N's 0.3677 AND 0.4pp worse than Phase O's 0.3502**. Trajectory clean (no rejections): iter-0 0.2730 (identical to Phase L iter-0 to 4dp; at coef 0.01 the value-head signal contributes effectively nothing at iter-0) → iter-1 0.2845 (no rejection unlike Phase O) → iter-2 0.3463. `promoted_iterations: [0, 1, 2]`, halted=false. Wall-clock 5m 23.2s. Dimensional check on coef ratio passes: iter-0 shape_attribution.value_head = 5.03 (Phase P) vs 26.01 (Phase O), ratio 5.17× matches the 5× coef ratio. **Lowering the coef did not help — the value-head-delta signal mechanism is wrong-shape, not wrong-magnitude.** R15.S3 BRANCH CLOSED across both axes: obs-delta saturated at 0.368 (axis 1, phases L/M/N/O'), value-head regressed at 0.346-0.350 (axis 2, phases O/P). Total branch cost ~36 min compute across 6 phases. Surviving F1-line candidates: R7 (multi-teacher labels) and R8 (DPO) — both autonomous-launch-INELIGIBLE. Full writeup at docs/ai-performance-research-progress.md § 'Phase P — F1 PPO + value-head tempo signal, coef 0.01 (R15.S3 GENUINE BRANCH CLOSEOUT)'.

Phase O' CLOSED — signal-mix axis fully explored. Dropped bench-energy + retreat (both effectively dead in Phase N attribution); scaled active-energy 0.02→0.03 and throughput 0.02→0.03; held hp-diff 0.05 as control. All 3 iters promoted, monotone trajectory 0.2825 → 0.2883 → 0.3677. Iter-2 Wilson **0.3677 identical to Phase N's 0.3677 to 4 decimal places** — signal-mix change moved iter-2 by 0.0000pp. Capstone observation for R15.S3 branch: 3 axes (coef magnitude / schedule / signal mix) each moved iter-2 by ≤1.2pp; the binding constraint is the information content of the 5-signal observation-delta family, not the signals' weights or schedule. Total R15.S3 branch cost ~25 min compute across 4 phases (L+M+N+O'). Branch CLOSED / SATURATED.
